candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Merko Ehitus’ financial performance weakened in the first half of 2026 despite a stronger second quarter and a substantially larger order book.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Six-month revenue declined 10.7% year on year to EUR 149.9 million, although second-quarter revenue increased 12.1% to EUR 92.7 million as major projects moved into more active construction phases.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Pre-tax profit fell to EUR 10.8 million from EUR 23.5 million, while net profit attributable to shareholders decreased to EUR 12.8 million from EUR 21.7 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Consequently, the net profit margin declined to 8.6% from 12.9%, and earnings per share fell to EUR 0.73 from EUR 1.22.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: In the second quarter, net profit was EUR 8.5 million, compared with EUR 11.2 million a year earlier.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Profitability was affected by lower margins in construction services and reduced real estate development volumes.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Group gross profit decreased to EUR 17.4 million from EUR 29.1 million, and operating profit fell 55.1% to EUR 8.4 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: The construction services segment generated EUR 118.3 million of revenue, down 1.5%, but operating profit dropped 65.5% to EUR 3.0 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Its operating margin declined to 2.6% from 7.3%, reflecting the expiration of particularly successful earlier contracts and a return to more typical margins in a highly competitive market.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Real estate development revenue decreased 33.9% to EUR 31.6 million, while operating profit fell 40.8% to EUR 7.0 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Apartment sales declined to 120 from 222, and revenue from apartment sales fell to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 44.9 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: However, second-quarter development revenue and operating profit increased modestly year on year.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: The main positive development was the secured order book, which reached a record EUR 835.7 million at 30 June 2026, up approximately 88% from EUR 443.8 million a year earlier.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: New contracts signed during the first half totaled EUR 486.4 million, more than double the prior-year amount.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Growth was driven largely by public-sector, Rail Baltica, defence-related and energy-infrastructure projects.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The Rūdninkai defence force campus entered full-scale construction after the reporting date; its two phases have a combined construction cost exceeding EUR 370 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Cash and cash equivalents rose to EUR 39.6 million from EUR 25.9 million, but operating cash flow was negative at EUR 31.6 million, primarily because of increased inventories and construction-contract balances.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Residential development investment increased to EUR 42.6 million from EUR 22.5 million, supported by additional borrowing.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Net debt rose to EUR 29.6 million, while the equity ratio remained strong at 57.4%.
candidate_sentence_map.S20: Overall, Merko entered the second half with weaker earnings and cash conversion but a significantly stronger project pipeline and increased construction activity.
